title: HeliQwest International
specs: Specializes in environmentally friendly longline vertical reference external load techniques
Uses state-of-the-art equipment like Differential Signal Global Positioning Systems (DGPS)
Flight crews have an average of over 6500 flight hours logged
blurb: HeliQwest specializes in external load and specialty helicopter operations including seismic, aerial harvesting, inspection, surveillance, mapping, photography, survey, forest fire suppression, and general transport. They use environmentally friendly longline vertical reference external load techniques with state-of-the-art equipment like DGPS. Their crews have extensive experience and safety is a key focus.
